name: aspira-kit
description: The Aspira Labs development kit: ui, config, the kit CLI and the agents. One repo, one version, every project.

scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:build
scripts.test:build: node packages/ui/scripts/mcp-smoke.mjs && rm -rf .packs && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" exec pnpm pack --pack-destination "$PWD/.packs" && node -e "const f=require('node:fs').readdirSync('.packs');const want=['aspiralabs-ui-','aspiralabs-config-','aspiralabs-ai-'];if(f.length!==3||!want.every(w=>f.filter(n=>n.startsWith(w)&&n.endsWith('.tgz')).length===1)){console.error('expected exactly one tarball each of ui, config and ai, found: '+f.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"
